description_en: Disassociates a transit router policy table
description_zh: 解除策略路由表关联关系
name: DisassociateTransitRouterPolicyTable

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Checks include permissions and instance status. Valid values:

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the transit router policy table association is removed.
true: sends a dry run request. The system only performs the check and does not remove the transit router policy table association. The system checks whether required parameters are specified and whether the request format is valid. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the corresponding request ID is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接解除策略路由表关联关系。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会解除策略路由表关联关系。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回对应请求ID
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the association between the transit router policy table and the network instance connection
parameters.help_zh: 策略路由表与网络实例连接的关联ID
parameters.name: association_id
